description: This file defines the GLAccountBalanceHolder class, which manages collections of GLAccount objects along with their associated debit and credit balances within a financial or accounting context.

classes.name: GLAccountBalanceHolder
classes.description: A container class that holds mappings of GLAccount objects and their associated debit and credit balances, providing methods to add amounts to respective balances.

methods.name: addToCredit
methods.description: Adds a specified amount to the credit balance of the given GLAccount.

methods.name: addToDebit
methods.description: Adds a specified amount to the debit balance of the given GLAccount.

methods.name: addToProperBalance
methods.description: Internal helper method that updates the appropriate balance map with the given amount for a specified account.
